items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive for London game vs Colts.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late in week practice.
items.implication: Commanders pass game thinned further with Daniels already out; elevates other WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining Commanders receivers.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip injury; cleared without snap restriction.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected in high-profile matchup.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries: IN Nacua/Collins/Swift/Irving/Pollard/Wright/Okonkwo/Coleman; Q McConkey/Flowers/McLaurin/Evans/Coker/Sadiq/Allen/Spears/Parkinson/Davis; OUT Williams/Daniels/White/Mayfield/McMillan/Jefferson/Mason/Hall/Mitchell/Taylor/Cooper/Smith/Goedert/Brown/Price/Charbonnet/Achane/Douglas/etc.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle, Q) expected to play today.
items.implication: Committee back available; Pollard also IN.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans practiced late week despite rib injury; will do best to play, team optimistic (Kittle: fractured ribs suck).
items.implication: Potential WR availability boosts SF pass game; Kittle elevated if limited.
items.opportunity: Routes if active; else TE/WR bump.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (quad, Q) unlikely to play Sunday night vs Lions.
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey likely to play today after foot injury (LP-DNP-LP); not as serious as prior rib.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snaps if active.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring, limited) expected to play today; was questionable.
items.why: Limited practices but source confirms expected.

items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest); signed Velus Jones Jr. from PS.
items.implication: SEA RB depth hit; Walker primary if healthy.

items.text: Colts WR Keenan Allen downgraded OUT (groin) vs Commanders; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.
Puka Nacua great to have back (hip) but possible snap limits TBD; Nico Collins excellent return spot (Cowboys inflate WR scoring +7.3% most in NFL, Texans 7th-most implied pts).
items.why: Hip return + elite DvP/implied for Collins.
items.implication: Nacua WR1 with caveat; Collins smash spot.
items.opportunity: Full or near targets for both; Collins volume spike.

items.text: Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun vs Rams; Jordan Addison truthers moment - home vs borderline secondary with JJ out.
items.why: Key absences + JJ OUT creates Addison opportunity.
items.implication: Eagles offense downgraded; Addison WR1 upside.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; Eagles WRs/TE remaining elevated or script worse.

items.text: Parlay lean: Garrett Wilson (no AD Mitchell) as underdog + Michael Wilson 7+ targets + Addison without Jefferson vs MIA.
Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP; already dealt with cracked rib this season.
items.implication: Monitor status closely; risk if active.
items.opportunity: If plays, prior volume; else WR depth.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ yds to RB every game.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 utilization, 26 touches (more than W1+2), Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd), double-digit target share every game.

LOVE Drake London (Penix 35%+ TS career/43.5% last); Garrett Wilson (no Mitchell, 36% prior); Josh Downs (31% TS, 43% RZ, WAS worst vs WR/slot); George Kittle (climbing share, Evans GTD, DEN soft vs TE).

HATE Omarion Hampton (low usage 42% snaps/3.5% TS/13% 3rd, SEA 2.9 YPC); Justin Herbert (pressured 44%, SEA elite pass D, low implied); Kyle Pitts (low TS w/ Penix); Emeka Egbuka (rookie QB, low RZ, low total); Xavier Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice).
